text:
clare: Quick note from new hire onboarding: sample-apps and the CLI use different env names for creds. It broke the quickstart. Found REDWOOD_TOKEN, REDWOOD_KEY, REDWOOD_API_KEY all in the wild. Which one should be canonical?

toni: Ugh. We never fully standardized. My vote is REDWOOD_API_KEY as the canonical env var and keep CLI flag --api-key for explicit runs.

rahul: Agree. Also need to be explicit about scoping. Right now some repos append project id to the key string and other places expect REDWOOD_PROJECT. Can we standardize on separate envs REDWOOD_ORG and REDWOOD_PROJECT, and discourage embedding scope inside the key?

kevin: Parity note: our Go sampleapp reads REDWOOD_TOKEN and ignores REDWOOD_API_KEY. That caused a support ticket this morning. I'll patch the Go SDK to accept both but warn when non-canonical var used.

clare: Good. Also rotation: sample CI wants ephemeral sessions. Let's document a /sessions flow and provide a tiny helper script in sample-apps (scripts/ci_get_session.sh) that exchanges a long-lived key for a short-lived token. Recommend token prefix: rs_ for session, rk_ for long-lived.

toni: We should also change retry behavior: SDKs must not retry on 401. If a 401 happens, surface a clear AuthError that suggests "possible rotation" and include the header x-redwood-auth-reason if present. JS currently retries once because of shared retry logic.

rahul: I'll update Python to raise RedwoodAuthError with fields message and maybe_rotated: true when status 401. Also add telemetry event auth.failure.rotated_candidate with counts so we can alert if many clients break simultaneously.

kevin: I'll open a tiny RFC and a docs patch. Also adding a linter rule (cred-lint) to flag env var names that aren't the canonical set.

ci-bot: link: https://redwood.internal/docs/devtools/auth-onboarding (CI check)

clare: Thanks team. Action items: 1) Docs PR standardizing REDWOOD_API_KEY + REDWOOD_ORG/PROJECT + prefix guidance, 2) SDK patches to accept fallbacks but warn, 3) change retry logic to never retry 401, 4) add sample-app scripts for session exchange. Who volunteers to triage SDKs?

toni: I can own JS and the retry fix.

rahul: I will do Python and the telemetry event.

kevin: I'll do Go + cred-lint rule.

clare: Awesome. Let's aim to ship docs + sample script this week so onboarding doesn't hit another new hire. Thanks!
